questions.question_text: Which list identifies the coefficient and individual pronumeral factors of $12z$?

options.why: This repeats $z$ twice, giving $12z^2$ instead of $12z$.

questions.question_text: Which list identifies the individual pronumeral factors of $mn$?

options.why: This keeps the pronumerals together instead of identifying the individual factors $m$ and $n$.

questions.question_text: Which list identifies the individual pronumeral factors of $r^2$, showing repeated factors?

options.why: This writes only one factor of $r$; the power $2$ requires two.
This treats the exponent as a coefficient, giving $2r$ instead of $r^2$.
This writes three factors of $r$, giving $r^3$ instead of $r^2$.

questions.question_text: Which list identifies the coefficient and individual pronumeral factors of $9hk$?

options.why: This replaces $h$ with another $k$, giving $9k^2$ instead of $9hk$.
This uses $3$ as the coefficient instead of $9$, giving $3hk$.

questions.solution_text:
$9hk=9\times h\times k$
The factors are $9$, $h$ and $k$.

questions.question_text: Which list identifies the coefficient and individual pronumeral factors of $10p^2q^2$, showing repeated factors?

options.why: This writes each pronumeral only once, giving $10pq$ instead of $10p^2q^2$.
This omits the second factor of $q$, giving $10p^2q$.
This omits the second factor of $p$, giving $10pq^2$.

questions.solution_text:
$10p^2q^2=10\times p\times p\times q\times q$
The factors are $10$, $p$, $p$, $q$ and $q$.

questions.question_text: Which list identifies the coefficient and individual pronumeral factors of $16a^3b$, showing repeated factors?

options.why: This writes only two factors of $a$, giving $16a^2b$ instead of $16a^3b$.
This applies the power $3$ to $b$ instead of $a$, giving $16ab^3$.
This multiplies the coefficient by the exponent instead of repeating $a$ three times, giving $48ab$.

questions.solution_text:
$16a^3b=16\times a\times a\times a\times b$
The factors are $16$, $a$, $a$, $a$ and $b$.
